title: Rabbi David Tawil: Understanding the Amida- “Modim”

chapters.title: Introduction to Modim
chapters.about: Overview of the third section of the Amidah and the Modim prayer.

chapters.title: Analyzing the Text of Modim
chapters.about: Breaking down the phrases regarding Hashem as our rock and the protector of our lives.

chapters.title: Lives and Souls in Hashem's Hands
chapters.about: The concept of our lives and nishamot being a pikadon watched over by Hashem.

chapters.title: Prayer and Daily Gratitude
chapters.about: The significance of praying three times a day and acknowledging Hashem's constant goodness.

chapters.title: The Meaning of Chayim and Birkat HaGomel
chapters.about: The connection between the word chayim and the four reasons for reciting Birkat HaGomel.

chapters.title: Finding Hashem in the Daily Grind
chapters.about: The importance of recognizing Hashem's hand in everyday life versus waiting for open miracles.

chapters.title: The Modim D'Rabanan
chapters.about: Why the rabbis instituted a separate Modim for the congregation during the repetition.

chapters.title: The Laws of Bowing
chapters.about: The history and halakhic limitations regarding bowing during the Amidah.

chapters.title: Tefillin and Emunah
chapters.about: How tefillin helps us internalize the belief that daily life is a miracle.

summary: Rabbi Tawil explores the themes of the Modim prayer in the Amidah, focusing on gratitude for Hashem's constant vigilance and the miracles hidden within everyday life. He discusses the significance of acknowledging Hashem's role in our daily existence and explains why the rabbis established the Modim D'Rabanan during the repetition of the Amidah. The class also touches upon the relationship between bowing, gratitude, and the nature of emunah.
questions: Why do we bow during the Modim prayer?
What is the purpose of the Modim D'Rabanan prayer?
Why is it important to recognize Hashem in everyday life rather than just through open miracles?
What is the connection between the word chayim and Birkat HaGomel?
Why does the Modim prayer emphasize that our lives are in Hashem's hands?
